silk.definition:
n. a fabric made from the fine threads produced by certain insect larvae
n. animal fibers produced by silkworms and other larvae that spin cocoons and by most spiders
silk.translation:
n. 丝, 绸, 绸锻类, 丝织品
a. 丝的, 丝织的

silk cotton.translation: n. 丝光木棉; 吉贝; 红棉

silk grass.translation:
un. 针茅
[网络] 丝草

silk hat.translation: n. （帽身呈圆筒形的）大礼帽

silk stocking.translation: n. 穿着华丽的人, 丝袜

silk stocking disease.translation: [医] 丝袜病, 小腿绀红皮病

silk-screens.translation: (silk-screen 的复数) n. 丝网印刷

silk-stocking.translation: a. 穿绸袜的, 贵族一般的, 奢华的

silke.translation:
西尔克
n. (Silke)人名；(德、英)西尔克

silken.definition: s having a smooth, gleaming surface reflecting light
silken.translation: a. 丝的, 绸制的, 柔软的, 圆滑的

silkgrass.translation:
un. 针茅

silkier.definition: s. having a smooth, gleaming surface reflecting light
silkier.translation: a. 柔软的, 光滑的( silky的比较级 )

silkiest.definition: s. having a smooth, gleaming surface reflecting light
silkiest.translation: a. 柔软的, 光滑的( silky的最高级 )

silkily.translation: adv. 如丝绸一般地；（谈吐等）温和的

silkiness.definition:
n. The quality or state of being silky or silken; softness
   and smoothness.
n. Fig.: Effeminacy; weakness.

silking.translation: 丝纹, 丝条, 漆膜走丝(漆病)

silklike.definition: s having a smooth, gleaming surface reflecting light

silkman.definition: n. A dealer in silks; a silk mercer.
silkman.translation: n. 丝织品的制造者, 丝织品的出售者

silkmen.translation: n. 丝织品制造商；丝织品的出售者

silkolene.translation: 西科林(充丝薄棉布, 印花轧光)

silkool.translation: [日]西尔科尔(大豆蛋白质纤维)

silks.definition:
n. the brightly colored garments of a jockey; emblematic of the stable
n. a fabric made from the fine threads produced by certain insect larvae
n. animal fibers produced by silkworms and other larvae that spin cocoons and by most spiders
silks.translation: n. 丝( silk的复数形式 ); 绸; （用于缝纫的）丝线王室律师; 王室法律顾问

silkscreen.definition:
n a print made using a stencil process in which an image or design is superimposed on a very fine mesh screen and printing ink is squeegeed onto the printing surface through the area of the screen that is not covered by the stencil
v print by silkscreen
silkscreen.translation:
n. 丝网印刷,丝网印刷品
a. 丝网印刷的,用丝网印刷术印制的

silkscreened.definition:
past participle of silkscreen
n a print made using a stencil process in which an image or design is superimposed on a very fine mesh screen and printing ink is squeegeed onto the printing surface through the area of the screen that is not covered by the stencil
v print by silkscreen
silkscreened.translation:
(silkscreen 的过去分词) n.丝网印刷,丝网印刷品
a. 丝网印刷的,用丝网印刷术印制的

silkscreens.definition:
plural of silkscreen
n a print made using a stencil process in which an image or design is superimposed on a very fine mesh screen and printing ink is squeegeed onto the printing surface through the area of the screen that is not covered by the stencil
v print by silkscreen
silkscreens.translation:
(silkscreen 的复数) n.丝网印刷,丝网印刷品
a. 丝网印刷的,用丝网印刷术印制的

silkweed.definition: n any of numerous plants of the genus Asclepias having milky juice and pods that split open releasing seeds with downy tufts

silkwood.definition: n a fast-growing tropical American evergreen having white flowers and white fleshy edible fruit; bark yields a silky fiber used in cordage and wood is valuable for staves

silkworm.definition:
n. the commercially bred hairless white caterpillar of the domestic silkworm moth which spins a cocoon that can be processed to yield silk fiber; the principal source of commercial silk
n. larva of a saturniid moth; spins a large amount of strong silk in constructing its cocoon

silkworms.definition:
n. the commercially bred hairless white caterpillar of the domestic silkworm moth which spins a cocoon that can be processed to yield silk fiber; the principal source of commercial silk
n. larva of a saturniid moth; spins a large amount of strong silk in constructing its cocoon
silkworms.translation: n. 蚕( silkworm的复数形式 )

silky.definition: s having a smooth, gleaming surface reflecting light

silky anteater.translation: [网络] 第一名丝食蚁兽；侏食蚁兽
